A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Tele-Lens study despite the changed title. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A–E are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original probing experiments across 12 tasks, backbone evaluations, uncertainty-estimation results, and CoT-bypass experiments, including extensive appendix results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Section 2.5, Section 3, and the appendices. Retained experiments still constitute original results.

M1.justification: The Tele-Lens adapter, three probing targets, frozen LM head, pivot-selection procedures, and entropy-threshold CoT bypass remain unchanged. Added explanations justify the existing procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 12 tasks spanning explicit composition, implicit composition, and knowledge/semantics. Appendix A is unchanged; additional main-text plot panels reproduce existing appendix coverage.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same perplexity, entropy, and self-certainty baselines, alongside the same backbone, with/without-CoT, and random-guess comparisons. Newly discussed related methods are not evaluated.

E3.justification: Table 1 corrects the stated Parity probing window from the last six digits to the last four, matching the unchanged columns −4 through −1 plus the terminal reference position 0. This revises the reported evaluation description without establishing a rerun; other settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The stepwise Parity analysis, input-length confounding analysis, trajectory examples, pivot-count comparisons, and bypass-threshold sweeps are retained. Expanded main figures display analyses already present in v1's appendices.

E5.justification: Table 5 retains averaging over five repeated runs. Neither version adds or removes seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or comparable statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Tables 1–8 retain their numerical results, including Table 2's average AUROC of 0.69 for Tele-Lens Top-5 versus 0.60 for self-certainty. Expanded Figures 3 and 6 reuse existing appendix results; the reported findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations are retained. Uncertainty-metric formulas move from Appendix D to Section 3.1 and are renumbered. Added probing rationale is conceptual explanation, not a new formal assumption, derivation, or proof.

C1.justification: Both versions claim a myopic planning horizon, effective uncertainty estimation from sparse pivots, and proof-of-concept CoT bypass with negligible accuracy loss. The new title and shorter conclusion reframe the same substantive contributions.

C2.justification: v2 explains why final-answer tokens can anchor the measurement of latent foresight and newly interprets informative Tele-Lens signals as suggesting benefits from additional calibration training. It also develops adaptive-thinking implications. The fixed-answer-space limitation remains.

D1.justification: Appendices A and B retain the same preprocessing, sampling, hyperparameters, hardware, and training details. Code/data/model access information is unchanged. The full-trajectory probing clarification reiterates procedures already documented and illustrated in v1.

R1.justification: v2 adds research context on early exiting and steering, calibration, and Patchscopes, including citations to Yong, Yang, Li, Kapoor, and Ghandeharioun. It briefly explains the choice of trained probes. The existing step-entropy reference updated to Li et al. (2026b) is the same work.

P1.justification: The title changes, portions of the abstract and introduction are rewritten, research questions receive Q1/Q2 labels, and the conclusion is shortened. Metric definitions move into Section 3.1, and explanatory paragraphs are added; the core section structure remains.

P2.justification: Figure 3 expands the displayed CSQA plot to include Parity and MMLU; Figure 6 adds Parity and CSQA panels. These reuse appendix material. Figure sizing, placement, and captions are adjusted, including Table 1's digit-count correction.

improvement.justification: v2 makes the existing evidence easier to assess through clearer probing rationale, more informative main-figure contrasts, metric definitions beside their discussion, and the corrected Table 1 caption. Added research context also helps positioning. These provide limited clarity and interpretive gains while the empirical evidence remains unchanged.
